column3: The final object is my people in the singular, not peoples.
The first verb specifically concerns knowing the human being.
The request is to bend down the heavens rather than part them.
Your hands is plural; the waters are many rather than expressly deep.
Their mouth and right hand are singular, and the right hand of deception is repeated.
The sword is called evil rather than expressly deadly.
The mouth and right hand are singular, with right hand repeated.
The final negatives name breach and going out without separately specifying walls or captivity.
